key_point: The four Pac-Man ghosts are not the same
title: The four Pac-Man ghosts are not the same
caption: Each Pac-Man ghost has its own personality. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #pacman #namco

instagram.caption:
The four ghosts in Pac-Man do not move the same way. Each one has its own behavior.

Blinky chases you directly, Pinky tries to cut you off from the front, Inky depends on Blinky's position, and Clyde wanders off when he gets near.

Creator Toru Iwatani wanted them to feel like characters. Together they corner you in a way that feels almost smart.

Which ghost always got you?
